en.lesson.meet-the-kit.idea: A drum kit is a group of distinct voices. A relaxed setup lets each limb reach its instrument without twisting or lifting the shoulders.
en.lesson.meet-the-kit.step.1: Name kick, snare, hi-hat, tom, and crash. On the Practice Pad, those voices use Space, F, J, K, and L.
en.lesson.meet-the-kit.step.2: Sit so your thighs slope slightly down and your feet can rest on the pedals without reaching.
en.lesson.meet-the-kit.step.3: Use hearing protection around acoustic drums and keep headphone or monitor levels comfortable.
en.lesson.count-the-grid.idea: A steady beat is a set of evenly spaced positions. Eighth notes split each beat into two equal spaces.
en.lesson.count-the-grid.step.1: Say “1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &” at a comfortable pace. The numbers are the beats; each “&” sits halfway between them.
en.lesson.count-the-grid.step.2: Watch the Practice Pad playhead move through the numbered grid.
en.lesson.count-the-grid.step.3: Tap the snare evenly on every eighth-note position, then repeat while counting aloud.
en.lesson.first-backbeat.idea: A common rock and pop groove pairs kick on beats 1 and 3 with snare on beats 2 and 4. Even hi-hat eighths connect the pattern.
en.lesson.first-backbeat.step.2: Add the hi-hat on each number and “&”. Keep its volume even.
en.lesson.first-backbeat.step.3: Add kick on 1 and 3, then snare on 2 and 4. Keep the count moving through the whole bar.
en.lesson.first-fill.idea: A fill adds a short phrase near the end of a groove. A clear downbeat after the fill makes the transition feel settled.
en.lesson.first-fill.step.1: Play a simple groove for three beats and keep counting through beat 4.
en.lesson.first-fill.step.2: Use even eighth notes across the snare and tom on beat 4.
en.lesson.first-fill.step.3: Land kick and crash together on the next beat 1. Start slowly enough to make that landing comfortable.
en.lesson.sixteenth-control.idea: Sixteenth notes divide a beat into four equal positions, commonly counted “1 e & a”. Relaxed, even spacing matters more than speed.
en.lesson.sixteenth-control.step.1: Say “1 e & a” several times without playing.
en.lesson.sixteenth-control.step.2: Play four quiet, even snare taps on each beat.
en.lesson.sixteenth-control.step.3: Keep your hands low and relaxed. Increase tempo only while every subdivision stays even.
en.lesson.paradiddle-voices.idea: A single paradiddle is R-L-R-R, L-R-L-L. The repeated strokes are doubles; accents can make the sticking easier to hear.
en.lesson.paradiddle-voices.step.1: Say the sticking out loud and make the repeated hand change feel smooth.
en.lesson.paradiddle-voices.step.2: Accent the first note of each four-note group while keeping the other notes lower.
en.lesson.paradiddle-voices.step.3: Move selected notes from snare to tom without changing the sticking or pulse.
en.lesson.syncopated-pocket.idea: Syncopation places a note between the main beats. Keep the snare backbeat steady while the kick adds offbeat movement.
en.lesson.syncopated-pocket.step.1: Count the eighth-note grid and keep snare on beats 2 and 4.
en.lesson.syncopated-pocket.step.2: Add one kick on an “&” while keeping the other notes unchanged.
en.lesson.syncopated-pocket.step.3: Repeat the bar and notice whether the offbeat kick pulls the next beat early.
en.lesson.linear-fill.idea: A linear phrase gives each subdivision to one voice at a time. Separating the voices makes a fill clear and controlled.
en.lesson.linear-fill.step.1: Count each subdivision at a slow tempo.
en.lesson.linear-fill.step.2: Play the kick, snare, and tom sequence one note at a time; let each sound finish before the next voice.
en.lesson.linear-fill.step.3: Keep the final subdivision clear so the next groove can begin on beat 1.
en.lesson.limb-independence.idea: Independence grows by layering one steady part at a time. Make the foot pattern automatic before adding a hand part.
en.lesson.limb-independence.step.1: Tap a steady kick pulse and count aloud for several bars.
en.lesson.limb-independence.step.2: Keep the kick going while adding a simple hi-hat pulse.
en.lesson.limb-independence.step.3: Add the snare backbeat last. If a layer slips, remove it and rebuild from the pulse.
en.lesson.limb-independence.goal.2: Add one hand at a time
en.lesson.five-four.idea: Five-four has five quarter-note beats in each bar. Grouping it as 3 + 2 gives the phrase a repeatable shape.
en.lesson.five-four.step.1: Count “1 2 3, 1 2” and accent each group’s first beat.
en.lesson.five-four.step.2: Keep the hi-hat evenly spaced across all five beats.
en.lesson.five-four.step.3: Place the kick and snare while keeping the 3 + 2 count audible.
en.lesson.dynamic-arc.idea: Dynamics describe how softly or strongly you play. A quiet note and an accent should differ in volume while staying in time.
en.lesson.dynamic-arc.step.1: Play one bar of soft notes at an easy tempo.
en.lesson.dynamic-arc.step.2: Repeat with one clear accent, keeping the remaining notes soft.
en.lesson.dynamic-arc.step.3: Build the volume gradually over four bars without speeding up.
en.lesson.three-over-two.idea: A 3:2 polyrhythm places three evenly spaced notes over the same span as two evenly spaced notes. Learn each pulse separately before combining them.
en.lesson.three-over-two.step.1: Clap two even notes across a steady two-beat span.
en.lesson.three-over-two.step.2: Over the same span, sing three evenly spaced notes: “1, trip, let”.
en.lesson.three-over-two.step.3: Keep the two-beat pulse in your foot while speaking the three-note phrase. Begin slowly.

en.pattern.twelve-eight-shuffle.focus: Hold four triplet groups with a deep backbeat
en.pattern.nine-eight-grouping.name: Nine-Eight Grouping
en.pattern.nine-eight-grouping.description: An odd-meter exercise with nine eighth-note steps grouped as two, two, two, and three.
en.pattern.nine-eight-grouping.focus: Hear the final group of three before the bar turns
en.pattern.seven-eight-long-group.name: Seven-Eight 3 + 2 + 2
en.pattern.seven-eight-long-group.descripti: A seven-eighth phrase grouped as three, two, and two with clear kick and snare anchors.
en.pattern.seven-eight-long-group.focus: Keep the three-note opening group distinct
en.pattern.five-four-two-three.name: Five-Four 2 + 3
en.pattern.five-four-two-three.description: A five-beat rock phrase grouped as two plus three with a stable eighth-note guide.
en.pattern.five-four-two-three.focus: Feel the two-beat pickup into the longer group
en.pattern.five-four-syncopated.name: Five-Four Syncopation
en.pattern.five-four-syncopated.description: A more displaced kick pattern over a five-beat grouping, with snare notes marking the turns.
en.pattern.five-four-syncopated.focus: Keep syncopated kicks inside the five-beat phrase
en.pattern.three-four-jazz-waltz.name: Jazz Waltz Ride
en.pattern.three-four-jazz-waltz.descriptio: A triplet-grid ride pattern with light kick support and sparse snare comping.
en.pattern.three-four-jazz-waltz.focus: Keep the triplet ride flowing across three beats
en.pattern.twelve-eight-gospel.name: Twelve-Eight Gospel Pulse
en.pattern.twelve-eight-gospel.description: A compound triplet exercise with a steady guide, moving kick, and backbeat anchors.
en.pattern.twelve-eight-gospel.focus: Keep a flowing triplet hand while displacing the kick
en.pattern.broken-sixteenth-hats.name: Broken Sixteenth Hats
en.pattern.broken-sixteenth-hats.descriptio: A broken hat orchestration with gaps while syncopated kit voices fill the rhythmic space.
en.pattern.broken-sixteenth-hats.focus: Keep a consistent internal sixteenth-note count
en.pattern.four-over-three-accent.name: Four-Beat Accent Displacement
en.pattern.four-over-three-accent.descripti: A repeating accent cycle crosses the bar line over a stable four-beat foundation.
en.pattern.four-over-three-accent.focus: Hold the backbeat while accents shift every three steps
en.pattern.one-bar-tom-ascent.name: One-Bar Tom Ascent
en.pattern.one-bar-tom-ascent.description: A one-bar fill study that moves from snare to toms and lands on a crash.
en.pattern.one-bar-tom-ascent.focus: Move a steady sixteenth-note fill around the kit
en.pattern.one-bar-tom-descent.name: One-Bar Tom Descent
en.pattern.one-bar-tom-descent.description: A descending fill that travels from high tom back to snare with a clear final accent.
en.pattern.one-bar-tom-descent.focus: Play even singles while moving down the toms
en.pattern.one-bar-linear-fill.name: One-Bar Linear Fill
en.pattern.one-bar-linear-fill.description: A challenging linear fill where each sixteenth-note step moves to a different kit voice.
en.pattern.one-bar-linear-fill.focus: Play the fill without overlapping drum voices
en.pattern.rock-groove-into-fill.name: Rock Groove → Fill
en.pattern.rock-groove-into-fill.descriptio: Play a straight rock beat for one bar, then move through a simple snare and tom fill. The phrase loops back to the downbeat.
en.pattern.rock-groove-into-fill.focus: Keep the first bar steady and make the second-bar fill resolve
en.pattern.pop-groove-into-fill.name: Pop Groove → Fill
en.pattern.pop-groove-into-fill.description: A steady pop bar followed by a short tom fill and a crash to lead into the next loop.
en.pattern.pop-groove-into-fill.focus: Keep the pop backbeat clear before a compact fill
en.pattern.funk-groove-into-fill.name: Funk Groove → Fill
en.pattern.funk-groove-into-fill.descriptio: A syncopated sixteenth-note funk bar moves into a linear fill that resolves with a crash.
en.pattern.funk-groove-into-fill.focus: Preserve the syncopated pocket through the fill
en.pattern.shuffle-groove-into-fill.name: Shuffle → Triplet Fill
en.pattern.shuffle-groove-into-fill.descrip: A blues shuffle bar followed by a triplet-based snare and tom fill with a clear resolution.
en.pattern.shuffle-groove-into-fill.focus: Keep the swung subdivision consistent into the fill
en.pattern.half-time-groove-into-fill.name: Half-Time Groove → Fill
en.pattern.half-time-groove-into-fill.descr: A spacious half-time first bar contrasts with a sixteenth-note fill in the second bar.
en.pattern.half-time-groove-into-fill.focus: Hold the slow backbeat while counting the faster fill
en.pattern.fill-quarter-note-snare.name: Fill: Quarter-Note Snare
en.pattern.fill-quarter-note-snare.descript: A first fill using one relaxed snare hit on each beat. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 and leave the spaces even.
en.pattern.fill-quarter-note-snare.focus: Keep four evenly spaced strokes across the bar
en.pattern.fill-eighth-note-snare.name: Fill: Eighth-Note Snare
en.pattern.fill-eighth-note-snare.descripti: Play two snare notes per beat with an even, unaccented touch before adding speed.
en.pattern.fill-eighth-note-snare.focus: Keep the eighth-note hand motion steady
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-eighths.name: Fill: Beat Four Eighths
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-eighths.descripti: Two simple snare notes on the final beat make a compact pickup into the next bar.
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-eighths.focus: Start the fill on beat four and land the next downbeat cleanly
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-sixteenths.name: Fill: Beat Four Sixteenths
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-sixteenths.descri: Play four snare notes on beat four. Start slowly and keep all four notes the same distance apart.
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-sixteenths.focus: Count four even notes on the last beat
en.pattern.fill-two-beat-eighths.name: Fill: Two-Beat Eighths
en.pattern.fill-two-beat-eighths.descriptio: A short two-beat snare fill that leaves the first half of the measure open for counting.
en.pattern.fill-two-beat-eighths.focus: Keep the eighth-note fill even across beats three and four
en.pattern.fill-snare-to-tom-eighths.name: Fill: Snare to Tom Eighths
en.pattern.fill-snare-to-tom-eighths.descri: Play two eighth notes on snare followed by two on tom during the final two beats.
en.pattern.fill-snare-to-tom-eighths.focus: Move from snare to tom without changing the pulse
en.pattern.fill-eighth-note-toms.name: Fill: Eighth-Note Toms
en.pattern.fill-eighth-note-toms.descriptio: An easy full-bar tom pattern with one note on every eighth-note count.
en.pattern.fill-eighth-note-toms.focus: Keep both hands even while moving around the kit
en.pattern.fill-snare-toms-crash.name: Fill: Snare, Toms, Crash
en.pattern.fill-snare-toms-crash.descriptio: Three sixteenths move from snare to tom, with a crash on the last sixteenth as a pickup into the loop.
en.pattern.fill-snare-toms-crash.focus: Shape a short fill and accent its final stroke
en.pattern.fill-last-two-beats-sixteenths.n: Fill: Last Two Beats in Sixteenths
en.pattern.fill-last-two-beats-sixteenths.d: An eight-note sixteenth fill across beats three and four, ending with an accented tom pickup.
en.pattern.fill-last-two-beats-sixteenths.f: Count e-and-a while moving from snare to tom
en.pattern.fill-eighth-snare-tom-alternatio: Alternate snare and tom on eighth notes for a clear, familiar fill sound.
Change drum voices without changing note spacing
en.pattern.fill-snare-tom-descent-eighths.d: Eighth-note groups move from snare to tom and back to snare, with accents marking the start and finish.
en.pattern.fill-snare-tom-descent-eighths.f: Make each voice change clear without breaking the pulse
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-tom-sixteenths.de: Move four sixteenths from snare to tom on the final beat, then resolve the phrase on the next downbeat.
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-tom-sixteenths.fo: Fit four quick notes into beat four without rushing
en.pattern.fill-kick-snare-eighths.name: Fill: Kick and Snare Eighths
en.pattern.fill-kick-snare-eighths.descript: Alternate kick and snare for a compact two-beat fill that develops limb coordination.
en.pattern.fill-kick-snare-eighths.focus: Keep the feet and hands evenly spaced
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-triplets.name: Fill: Beat Four Triplets
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-triplets.descript: A three-note triplet pickup on beat four. Keep the swing subdivision steady through the bar line.
en.pattern.fill-beat-four-triplets.focus: Fit three even notes across the last beat
en.pattern.fill-one-bar-triplets.name: Fill: Snare and Tom Triplets
en.pattern.fill-one-bar-triplets.descriptio: A full-bar triplet fill that moves between snare and tom with a clear accent on each beat.
en.pattern.fill-one-bar-triplets.focus: Keep all four triplet groups the same width
en.pattern.fill-sixteenth-tom-cascade.name: Fill: Sixteenth Tom Cascade
en.pattern.fill-sixteenth-tom-cascade.descr: A continuous sixteenth-note run that starts on snare, travels through the tom voice, and finishes with a crash accent.
en.pattern.fill-sixteenth-tom-cascade.focus: Keep sixteen notes flowing as one phrase
en.pattern.fill-sixteenth-kick-snare-tom.de: A full-bar orchestration that threads kick, snare, and tom through an even sixteenth-note stream.
en.pattern.fill-sixteenth-kick-snare-tom.fo: Keep the sixteenth grid steady as the sticking moves around the kit
en.pattern.fill-linear-kick-snare-tom.name: Fill: Linear Kick-Snare-Tom
en.pattern.fill-linear-kick-snare-tom.descr: A syncopated linear fill uses kick, snare, and tom without overlapping voices, then resolves on the final crash.
en.pattern.fill-linear-kick-snare-tom.focus: Play one voice at a time and preserve the gaps in the phrase
en.pattern.fill-accent-groups-of-three.name: Fill: Sixteenths Accented in Threes
en.pattern.fill-accent-groups-of-three.desc: Sixteenth notes continue evenly as accents repeat every three steps, shifting against the four-beat bar.
en.pattern.fill-accent-groups-of-three.focu: Keep the pulse steady while accents cross the beat
en.pattern.fill-paradiddle-voices.name: Fill: Paradiddle Orchestration
en.pattern.fill-paradiddle-voices.descripti: An eight-note R-L-R-R, L-R-L-L sticking study orchestrated between snare and tom with accents on each group start.
en.pattern.fill-paradiddle-voices.focus: Accent the paradiddle while moving the notes between snare and tom
en.pattern.fill-triplet-linear.name: Fill: Linear Triplet Displacement
en.pattern.fill-triplet-linear.description: A syncopated triplet fill moves a single voice at a time around the kit and accents the final note.
en.pattern.fill-triplet-linear.focus: Keep the triplet flow as the kick and hands trade places
en.pattern.fill-six-eight-compound.name: Fill: Six-Eight Compound Tom Run
en.pattern.fill-six-eight-compound.descript: A compound-meter fill places even sixteenths across two dotted-quarter pulses and resolves with a crash.
en.pattern.fill-six-eight-compound.focus: Group the six eighth notes in two sets of three
en.pattern.fill-five-four-cascade.name: Fill: Five-Four Sixteenth Cascade
en.pattern.fill-five-four-cascade.descripti: A five-beat phrase of flowing sixteenths with snare, tom, and kick movement marking the grouping.
en.pattern.fill-five-four-cascade.focus: Count five beats as the fill travels across the longer measure
en.pattern.fill-seven-eight-grouped.name: Fill: Seven-Eight Grouped Accents
en.pattern.fill-seven-eight-grouped.descrip: A fourteen-note sixteenth fill in 7/8 marks each group with an accent before resolving at the next bar.
en.pattern.fill-seven-eight-grouped.focus: Feel the 3 + 2 + 2 grouping through the fill
en.pattern.fill-tom-build-crash.name: Fill: Sixteenth Tom Build
en.pattern.fill-tom-build-crash.description: A dynamic tom build rises through the bar and lands on an accented crash at the end of the phrase.
en.pattern.fill-tom-build-crash.focus: Build intensity without changing the sixteenth-note spacing

es.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Ruta de aprendizaje
es.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Doce lecciones guiadas, desde la primera configuración hasta la polirritmia.
es.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Entrenador
es.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Practica con rondas ajustables, tempo adaptativo, entradas calibradas y acompañamiento de listas.
es.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Panel de práctica
es.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Entrena el ritmo con cinco voces de batería y comentarios claros.
es.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudimentos
es.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Desarrolla el control con técnica, acentos y guía enfocada.
es.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Ritmos
es.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Sigue patrones originales de rock, pop, funk, reggae, shuffle, música latina y compases irregulares, de fácil a avanzado.
es.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Biblioteca de canciones
es.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Crea partes de batería, organiza tu repertorio y practica secciones.
es.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Guía de batería
es.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Ajusta el instrumento con comodidad, conoce cada voz y protege tu audición.
es.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Progreso
es.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Consulta lecciones completadas, mejores puntuaciones, sesiones recientes y tu racha.
es.meta.app.description: Un estudio de práctica enfocado en técnica de batería, ritmo, grooves y confianza musical.

Un studio, pas un fil sans fin.

fr.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Découvrir la batterie
fr.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Apprenez les principales sonorités, installez-vous correctement et écoutez sans risque.
fr.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Compter la grille
fr.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Repérez les noires et les croches dans le temps.
fr.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Créer son premier backbeat
fr.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Coordonnez grosse caisse, caisse claire et charleston dans un groove complet.
fr.lesson.first-fill.title: Un break qui retombe juste
fr.lesson.first-fill.summary: Déplacez des coups simples sur le kit et revenez clairement sur le premier temps.
fr.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Maîtriser les doubles croches
fr.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Divisez un temps en quatre notes régulièrement espacées.
fr.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Orchestrer le paradiddle
fr.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Transformez les doigtés en mouvement musical entre caisse claire et toms.
fr.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Maîtriser les contretemps
fr.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Ajoutez des coups de grosse caisse syncopés sans déplacer la caisse claire.
fr.lesson.linear-fill.title: Construire un break linéaire
fr.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Créez des breaks où deux membres ne frappent jamais ensemble.
fr.lesson.limb-independence.title: Superposer les mouvements
fr.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Gardez un ostinato au pied tandis que les mains jouent des phrases.
fr.lesson.five-four.title: Rendre la mesure à cinq naturelle
fr.lesson.five-four.summary: Groupez le 5/4 en 3 + 2 pour créer un groove régulier.
fr.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Dessiner une courbe dynamique
fr.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Contrôlez notes fantômes, accents et crescendos sans changer de tempo.
fr.lesson.three-over-two.title: Entendre trois sur deux
fr.Check each item after you can do it comf: Cochez chaque élément lorsque vous le maîtrisez confortablement.
fr.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Parcours d’apprentissage
fr.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Douze leçons guidées, de l’installation aux polyrythmies.
fr.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Entraînement
fr.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Entraînez-vous avec des séries réglables, un tempo adaptatif, des entrées calibrées et un accompagnement de setlist.
fr.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Pad de pratique
fr.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Travaillez le rythme avec cinq sons de batterie et un retour clair.
fr.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudiments
fr.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Développez votre contrôle avec des doigtés, des accents et des conseils ciblés.
fr.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Grooves
fr.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Suivez des motifs originaux de rock, pop, funk, reggae, shuffle, latin et mesures irrégulières, du niveau débutant à avancé.
fr.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Bibliothèque de morceaux
fr.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Créez des parties de batterie, organisez votre répertoire et travaillez les sections.
fr.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Guide de batterie
fr.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Installez-vous confortablement, découvrez chaque son et protégez votre ouïe.
fr.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Progression
fr.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Consultez les leçons terminées, vos meilleurs scores, vos séances récentes et votre série.
fr.meta.app.description: Un studio de pratique consacré à la technique de batterie, au rythme, aux grooves et à l’assurance musicale.

de.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Das Schlagzeug kennenlernen
de.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Lerne die wichtigsten Klänge kennen, richte dein Set ausgewogen ein und schütze dein Gehör.
de.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Das Raster zählen
de.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Lies Viertel- und Achtelnoten als Positionen im Takt.
de.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Deinen ersten Backbeat spielen
de.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Koordiniere Bassdrum, Snare und Hi-Hat zu einem vollständigen Groove.
de.lesson.first-fill.title: Ein Fill mit sicherer Landung
de.lesson.first-fill.summary: Verteile einzelne Schläge auf dem Set und kehre sauber zu Takt eins zurück.
de.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Sechzehntel kontrollieren
de.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Teile einen Schlag in vier gleichmäßig verteilte Noten.
de.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Das Paradiddle orchestrieren
de.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Verwandle das Handmuster in musikalische Bewegung zwischen Snare und Toms.
de.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Den Offbeat beherrschen
de.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Füge synkopierte Bassdrum-Schläge hinzu, ohne die Snare zu verschieben.
de.lesson.linear-fill.title: Ein lineares Fill bauen
de.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Spiele Fills, bei denen nie zwei Gliedmaßen gleichzeitig anschlagen.
de.lesson.limb-independence.title: Unabhängigkeit schichten
de.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Halte ein Fuß-Ostinato, während deine Hände darüber phrasieren.
de.lesson.five-four.title: Fünf natürlich fühlen
de.lesson.five-four.summary: Gruppiere 5/4 als 3 + 2 und finde einen wiederholbaren Groove.
de.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Einen Dynamikbogen formen
de.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Kontrolliere Ghostnotes, Akzente und Crescendi ohne Tempowechsel.
de.lesson.three-over-two.title: Drei über zwei hören
de.Check each item after you can do it comf: Hake jeden Punkt ab, sobald du ihn sicher beherrschst.
de.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Lernpfad
de.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Zwölf geführte Lektionen vom ersten Aufbau bis zur Polyrhythmik.
de.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Trainer
de.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Übe mit anpassbaren Runden, adaptivem Tempo, kalibrierten Eingängen und Setlist-Begleitung.
de.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Übungspad
de.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Trainiere dein Timing mit fünf spielbaren Schlagzeugstimmen und klarem Feedback.
de.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudiments
de.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Entwickle Kontrolle mit Schlagfolgen, Akzenten und gezieltem Coaching.
de.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Grooves
de.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Spiele eigene Rock-, Pop-, Funk-, Reggae-, Shuffle-, Latin- und ungerade Taktmuster von leicht bis anspruchsvoll.
de.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Songbibliothek
de.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Erstelle Schlagzeugparts, ordne dein Repertoire und übe Songabschnitte.
de.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Schlagzeug-Guide
de.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Richte dein Set bequem ein, lerne jeden Klang kennen und schütze dein Gehör.
de.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Fortschritt
de.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Sieh abgeschlossene Lektionen, Bestwerte, letzte Übungen und deine Serie.
de.meta.app.description: Ein fokussiertes Übungsstudio für Schlagzeugtechnik, Timing, Grooves und musikalisches Selbstvertrauen.

it.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Conosci la batteria
it.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Impara i suoni principali, regola il set in modo equilibrato e proteggi l’udito.
it.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Conta la griglia
it.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Leggi quarti e ottavi come posizioni nel tempo.
it.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Crea il tuo primo backbeat
it.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Coordina cassa, rullante e hi-hat in un groove completo.
it.lesson.first-fill.title: Un fill che atterra bene
it.lesson.first-fill.summary: Sposta colpi singoli sul set e torna con precisione al primo movimento.
it.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Controllo delle semicrome
it.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Dividi un movimento in quattro note equidistanti.
it.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Orchestra il paradiddle
it.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Trasforma la tecnica delle mani in movimento musicale tra rullante e tom.
it.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Domina il levare
it.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Aggiungi colpi sincopati di cassa senza spostare il rullante.
it.lesson.linear-fill.title: Progetta un fill lineare
it.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Crea fill in cui non colpiscono mai insieme due arti.
it.lesson.limb-independence.title: Indipendenza a strati
it.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Mantieni un ostinato con il piede mentre le mani fraseggiano.
it.lesson.five-four.title: Rendi naturale il cinque
it.lesson.five-four.summary: Raggruppa il 5/4 in 3 + 2 e crea un groove ripetibile.
it.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Dai forma a un arco dinamico
it.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Controlla ghost note, accenti e crescendo senza cambiare tempo.
it.lesson.three-over-two.title: Ascolta tre contro due
it.Check each item after you can do it comf: Seleziona ogni elemento quando riesci a farlo con sicurezza.
it.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Percorso di apprendimento
it.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Dodici lezioni guidate dalla prima configurazione alla poliritmia.
it.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Trainer
it.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Esercitati con round regolabili, tempo adattivo, ingressi calibrati e accompagnamento della scaletta.
it.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Pad di pratica
it.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Allena il tempo con cinque suoni di batteria e un feedback chiaro.
it.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudimenti
it.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Sviluppa il controllo con sticking, accenti e indicazioni mirate.
it.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Groove
it.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Segui pattern originali rock, pop, funk, reggae, shuffle, latini e in tempi dispari, dal livello base a quello avanzato.
it.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Libreria brani
it.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Crea parti di batteria, organizza il repertorio e prova le sezioni dei brani.
it.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Guida alla batteria
it.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Regola comodamente il set, conosci ogni suono e proteggi l’udito.
it.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Progressi
it.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Consulta lezioni completate, punteggi migliori, sessioni recenti e serie.
it.meta.app.description: Uno studio di pratica dedicato alla tecnica della batteria, al tempo, ai groove e alla sicurezza musicale.

nl.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: Heldere lessen, speelbare patronen en timingfeedback voor drummers van elk niveau. Geen account. Geen geluidsoverlast nodig.
nl.No setup or account needed. Use the five: Geen installatie of account nodig. Gebruik de vijf pads op het scherm of druk tijdens het aftellen op Spatie, F, J, K en L.
Druk op Start en volg de beat.
Probeer een paar slagen en bekijk daarna je timing.
nl.Set up an e-drum kit in Trainer: Stel een e-drumstel in bij Trainer
nl.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: Trainer ondersteunt USB-MIDI of optioneel microfooningang.
nl.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: Elke tool heeft één taak. Leer het idee, oefen de beweging apart en speel die daarna in een groove.
Je voortgang blijft in deze browser.
nl.No translation is available for this lan: Voor deze taal is nog geen vertaling beschikbaar.
nl.A focused place to learn, practise, and: Een plek om te leren, te oefenen en je drumvorderingen bij te houden.
nl.Build consistency one round at a time: Bouw stap voor stap aan vaste gewoonten
Plaats elke slag op de juiste plek.

Schrijf de partij die je hoort.
nl.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Leer het drumstel kennen
nl.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Leer de belangrijkste klanken, stel je set goed op en bescherm je gehoor.
nl.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Tel het raster
nl.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Lees kwart- en achtste noten als posities in de maat.
nl.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Speel je eerste backbeat
nl.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Coördineer kick, snare en hi-hat tot een complete groove.
nl.lesson.first-fill.title: Een fill die goed landt
nl.lesson.first-fill.summary: Verdeel losse slagen over het drumstel en keer strak terug naar tel één.
nl.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Zestienden beheersen
nl.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Verdeel één tel in vier gelijkmatig gespreide noten.
nl.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Orkestreer de paradiddle
nl.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Maak van je handzetting muzikale beweging tussen snare en toms.
nl.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Beheers de offbeat
nl.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Voeg gesyncopeerde kickslagen toe zonder de snare te verplaatsen.
nl.lesson.linear-fill.title: Bouw een lineaire fill
nl.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Speel fills waarbij nooit twee ledematen tegelijk slaan.
nl.lesson.limb-independence.title: Onafhankelijkheid stapelen
nl.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Houd een ostinato met je voet aan terwijl je handen erboven fraseren.
nl.lesson.five-four.title: Laat vijf natuurlijk voelen
nl.lesson.five-four.summary: Groepeer 5/4 als 3 + 2 voor een herhaalbare groove.
nl.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Vorm een dynamische boog
nl.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Beheers ghost notes, accenten en crescendo’s zonder het tempo te wijzigen.
nl.lesson.three-over-two.title: Hoor drie over twee
nl.Check each item after you can do it comf: Vink elk onderdeel aan zodra je het comfortabel kunt uitvoeren.
nl.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Leerroute
nl.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Twaalf begeleide lessen, van de eerste opstelling tot polyrhythmiek.
nl.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Trainer
nl.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Oefen met instelbare rondes, adaptief tempo, gekalibreerde invoer en begeleiding bij een setlist.
nl.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Oefenpad
nl.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Train je timing met vijf speelbare drumklanken en duidelijke feedback.
nl.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudiments
nl.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Ontwikkel controle met slagpatronen, accenten en gerichte coaching.
nl.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Grooves
nl.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Volg originele rock-, pop-, funk-, reggae-, shuffle-, Latin- en onevenmaatpatronen van eenvoudig tot gevorderd.
nl.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Nummersbibliotheek
nl.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Bouw drumpartijen, orden je repertoire en oefen songdelen.
nl.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Drumgids
nl.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Stel je set comfortabel op, leer elke klank kennen en bescherm je gehoor.
nl.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Voortgang
nl.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Bekijk voltooide lessen, topscores, recente oefensessies en je reeks.
nl.meta.app.description: Een gerichte oefenstudio voor drumtechniek, timing, grooves en muzikaal zelfvertrouwen.

pl.Drum learning, in time: Ucz się grać na perkusji w rytmie
pl.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: Przejrzyste lekcje, grywalne wzory i informacja o rytmie dla perkusistów na każdym poziomie. Bez konta i skarg na hałas.
pl.No setup or account needed. Use the five: Nie musisz nic konfigurować ani zakładać konta. Użyj pięciu padów na ekranie lub klawiszy Spacja, F, J, K i L podczas odliczania.
Zagraj kilka uderzeń i sprawdź swoje tempo.
pl.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: Trener obsługuje USB MIDI lub opcjonalne wejście mikrofonowe.
pl.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: Każde narzędzie ma jeden cel. Poznaj pomysł, przećwicz ruch osobno, a potem zagraj go w groove.
Twoje postępy zostają w tej przeglądarce.
pl.No translation is available for this lan: Tłumaczenie dla tego języka nie jest jeszcze dostępne.
Twój następny rytm zaczyna się tutaj.
pl.A focused place to learn, practise, and: Miejsce do nauki, ćwiczeń i śledzenia postępów w grze na perkusji.
Umieść każde uderzenie we właściwym miejscu.
Przygotuj się do gry na lata.
pl.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Poznaj zestaw perkusyjny
pl.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Poznaj podstawowe brzmienia, ustaw wygodnie instrument i chroń słuch.
pl.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Policz siatkę rytmiczną
pl.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Czytaj ćwierćnuty i ósemki jako pozycje w czasie.
pl.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Zagraj pierwszy backbeat
pl.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Połącz stopę, werbel i hi-hat w pełny groove.
pl.lesson.first-fill.title: Przejście z pewnym lądowaniem
pl.lesson.first-fill.summary: Rozmieść pojedyncze uderzenia na zestawie i wróć czysto na pierwszą miarę.
pl.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Kontrola szesnastek
pl.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Podziel jedną miarę na cztery równo rozłożone nuty.
pl.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Orkiestracja paradiddla
pl.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Zamień układ rąk w muzyczny ruch między werblem a tomami.
pl.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Opanuj synkopę
pl.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Dodaj synkopowane uderzenia stopy bez przesuwania werbla.
pl.lesson.linear-fill.title: Projektowanie linearnego przejścia
pl.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Buduj przejścia, w których dwie kończyny nigdy nie uderzają razem.
pl.lesson.limb-independence.title: Warstwowa niezależność
pl.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Utrzymuj ostinato stopą, a rękami graj nad nim frazy.
pl.lesson.five-four.title: Oswój metrum pięć
pl.lesson.five-four.summary: Grupuj 5/4 jako 3 + 2 i twórz powtarzalny groove.
pl.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Kształtowanie dynamiki
pl.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Kontroluj ghost notes, akcenty i crescendo bez zmiany tempa.
pl.lesson.three-over-two.title: Usłysz trzy na dwa
pl.Check each item after you can do it comf: Zaznacz każdy punkt, gdy wykonujesz go swobodnie.
pl.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Ścieżka nauki
pl.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Dwanaście lekcji od pierwszego ustawienia zestawu po polirytmię.
pl.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Trener
pl.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Ćwicz w regulowanych rundach, z adaptacyjnym tempem, skalibrowanym wejściem i podkładem do setlisty.
pl.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Pad do ćwiczeń
pl.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Ćwicz timing z pięcioma głosami zestawu i czytelną informacją zwrotną.
pl.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudimenty
pl.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Rozwijaj kontrolę dzięki układom rąk, akcentom i konkretnym wskazówkom.
pl.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Groove’y
pl.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Graj autorskie wzory rockowe, popowe, funkowe, reggae, shuffle, latynoskie i w nietypowych metrach — od łatwych po zaawansowane.
pl.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Biblioteka utworów
pl.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Twórz partie perkusji, porządkuj repertuar i ćwicz sekcje utworów.
pl.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Przewodnik po perkusji
pl.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Ustaw wygodnie zestaw, poznaj każde brzmienie i chroń słuch.
pl.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Postępy
pl.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Sprawdzaj ukończone lekcje, najlepsze wyniki, ostatnie ćwiczenia i serię.
pl.meta.app.description: Studio ćwiczeń skupione na technice gry na perkusji, timingu, groove’ach i pewności muzycznej.

uk.Drum learning, in time: Навчайтеся грати на барабанах у ритмі
uk.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: Зрозумілі уроки, ігрові ритми та відгук про таймінг для барабанщиків будь-якого рівня. Без облікового запису та скарг на шум.
uk.No setup or account needed. Use the five: Налаштування та обліковий запис не потрібні. Використовуй п’ять екранних педів або натискай Пробіл, F, J, K і L під час відліку.
Натисни Старт і стеж за ритмом.
Зіграй кілька ударів і перевір таймінг.
uk.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: Тренажер підтримує USB MIDI або додатковий вхід мікрофона.
uk.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: Кожен інструмент має одну мету. Зрозумій ідею, відпрацюй рух окремо, а потім зіграй його в груві.
Твій прогрес зберігається в цьому браузері.
uk.A focused place to learn, practise, and: Місце, щоб навчатися, практикуватися й відстежувати прогрес у грі на барабанах.
Розміщуй кожен удар на своєму місці.
uk.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Знайомство з установкою
uk.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Вивчи основні тембри, зручно налаштуй установку й бережи слух.
uk.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Рахуй ритмічну сітку
uk.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Сприймай чверті й восьмі як позиції в часі.
uk.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Зіграй перший бекбіт
uk.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Поєднай бас-барабан, малий барабан і хай-хет у повний грув.
uk.lesson.first-fill.title: Філ із чітким поверненням
uk.lesson.first-fill.summary: Переміщуй одиночні удари по установці й чітко повертайся на першу долю.
uk.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Контроль шістнадцятих
uk.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Поділи одну долю на чотири рівновіддалені ноти.
uk.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Оркеструй парадідл
uk.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Перетвори аплікатуру на музичний рух між малим барабаном і томами.
uk.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Відчуй слабкі долі
uk.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Додай синкоповані удари бас-барабана, не зміщуючи малий барабан.
uk.lesson.linear-fill.title: Створи лінійний філ
uk.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Грай філи, де дві кінцівки ніколи не б’ють одночасно.
uk.lesson.limb-independence.title: Незалежність шарами
uk.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Тримай остинато ногою, поки руки грають фрази поверх нього.
uk.lesson.five-four.title: Звикни до п’яти
uk.lesson.five-four.summary: Групуй 5/4 як 3 + 2 і створи повторюваний грув.
uk.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Формуй динамічну дугу
uk.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Контролюй ghost notes, акценти й крещендо без зміни темпу.
uk.lesson.three-over-two.title: Почуй три проти двох
uk.Check each item after you can do it comf: Позначайте кожен пункт, коли виконуєте його впевнено.
uk.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Шлях навчання
uk.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Дванадцять уроків: від першого налаштування до поліритмії.
uk.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Тренажер
uk.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Практикуйся в налаштовуваних раундах з адаптивним темпом, каліброваними входами й супроводом плейлиста.
uk.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Панель практики
uk.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Тренуй таймінг із п’ятьма тембрами установки та зрозумілим відгуком.
uk.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Рудименти
uk.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Розвивай контроль за допомогою аплікатури, акцентів і цільових підказок.
uk.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Груви
uk.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Грай авторські рок-, поп-, фанк-, регі-, шаффл-, латиноамериканські та непарні ритми — від простих до складних.
uk.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Бібліотека пісень
uk.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Створюй партії ударних, упорядковуй репертуар і практикуй частини пісень.
uk.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Путівник по барабанах
uk.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Зручно налаштуй установку, вивчи кожен тембр і бережи слух.
uk.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Прогрес
uk.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Переглядай завершені уроки, найкращі результати, останні заняття й серію.

ru.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: Понятные уроки, игровые ритмы и обратная связь по таймингу для барабанщиков любого уровня. Без аккаунта и жалоб на шум.
ru.No setup or account needed. Use the five: Настройка и аккаунт не нужны. Используй пять экранных пэдов или нажимай Пробел, F, J, K и L во время отсчёта.
Нажми Старт и следи за ритмом.
Сыграй несколько ударов и проверь тайминг.
ru.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: Тренажёр поддерживает USB MIDI или дополнительный вход микрофона.
ru.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: У каждого инструмента своя задача. Пойми идею, отработай движение отдельно, а затем сыграй его в груве.
Твой прогресс хранится в этом браузере.
ru.No translation is available for this lan: Перевод на этот язык пока недоступен.
ru.A focused place to learn, practise, and: Место, чтобы учиться, практиковаться и следить за прогрессом в игре на барабанах.
Поставь каждый удар на своё место.
ru.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Знакомство с установкой

ru.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Считай ритмическую сетку
ru.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Воспринимай четверти и восьмые как позиции во времени.
ru.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Сыграй первый бэкбит
ru.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Соедини бас-барабан, малый барабан и хай-хэт в полный грув.
ru.lesson.first-fill.title: Филл с точным возвращением
ru.lesson.first-fill.summary: Перемещай одиночные удары по установке и чётко возвращайся на первую долю.

ru.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Раздели одну долю на четыре равномерно распределённые ноты.
ru.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Оркеструй парадидл
ru.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Преврати аппликатуру в музыкальное движение между малым барабаном и томами.
ru.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Освой слабые доли
ru.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Добавь синкопированные удары бас-барабана, не смещая малый барабан.
ru.lesson.linear-fill.title: Создай линейный филл
ru.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Играй филлы, где две конечности никогда не бьют одновременно.
ru.lesson.limb-independence.title: Независимость слоями
ru.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Держи остинато ногой, пока руки играют фразы поверх него.
ru.lesson.five-four.title: Почувствуй размер пять
ru.lesson.five-four.summary: Группируй 5/4 как 3 + 2 и создай повторяемый грув.
ru.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Создай динамическую дугу
ru.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Контролируй ghost notes, акценты и крещендо без смены темпа.
ru.lesson.three-over-two.title: Услышь три против двух

ru.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Путь обучения
ru.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Двенадцать уроков от первой настройки установки до полиритмии.
ru.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Тренажёр
ru.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Занимайся в настраиваемых раундах с адаптивным темпом, откалиброванным вводом и сопровождением сет-листа.
ru.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Пэд для практики
ru.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Тренируй тайминг на пяти голосах установки и получай понятную обратную связь.
ru.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Рудименты
ru.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Развивай контроль с помощью аппликатуры, акцентов и точных подсказок.
ru.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Грувы
ru.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Играй авторские рок-, поп-, фанк-, регги-, шаффл-, латинские ритмы и размеры с нечётным числом долей — от простых до сложных.
ru.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Библиотека песен
ru.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Создавай партии ударных, упорядочивай репертуар и практикуй части песен.
ru.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Путеводитель по барабанам
ru.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Удобно настрой установку, изучи каждый тембр и береги слух.
ru.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Прогресс
ru.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Смотри завершённые уроки, лучшие результаты, недавние занятия и серию.
ru.meta.app.description: Студия для занятий барабанной техникой, таймингом, грувами и музыкальной уверенностью.

tr.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: Her seviyeden davulcu için açık dersler, çalınabilir kalıplar ve zamanlama geri bildirimi. Hesap gerekmez. Gürültü şikâyeti de.
tr.No setup or account needed. Use the five: Kurulum veya hesap gerekmez. Ekrandaki beş pedi kullan ya da sayım sırasında Boşluk, F, J, K ve L tuşlarına bas.
Başlat’a bas ve ritmi takip et.
Birkaç vuruş dene, sonra zamanlamanı incele.
tr.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: Eğitmen USB MIDI’yi veya isteğe bağlı mikrofon girişini destekler.
tr.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: Her aracın tek bir görevi var. Fikri öğren, hareketi ayrı çalış, sonra groove içinde çal.
tr.No translation is available for this lan: Bu dil için çeviri henüz yok.
tr.A focused place to learn, practise, and: Davul öğrenmek, pratik yapmak ve gelişimini takip etmek için bir alan.
tr.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Davul setini tanı
tr.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Temel sesleri öğren, setini dengeli kur ve işitmeni koru.

tr.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Dörtlük ve sekizlik notaları zaman içindeki konumlar olarak oku.
tr.lesson.first-backbeat.title: İlk backbeat’ini çal

tr.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: El düzenini trampet ve tomlar arasında müzikal harekete dönüştür.

tr.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Trampeti kaydırmadan senkoplu bas davul vuruşları ekle.

id.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: Pelajaran jelas, pola yang bisa dimainkan, dan masukan tempo bagi drummer di semua tingkat. Tanpa akun dan keluhan bising.
id.No setup or account needed. Use the five: Tidak perlu pengaturan atau akun. Gunakan lima pad di layar atau tekan Space, F, J, K, dan L saat hitung masuk.
Coba beberapa pukulan, lalu tinjau tempo.
id.Start with keyboard or touch: Mulai dengan papan ketik atau sentuhan
id.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: Pelatih mendukung USB MIDI atau masukan mikrofon opsional.
id.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: Setiap alat punya satu tujuan. Pelajari idenya, latih gerakannya, lalu mainkan dalam groove.
Berlatihlah dengan sengaja. Mainkan dengan musikal.
id.No translation is available for this lan: Terjemahan untuk bahasa ini belum tersedia.
Pukulan terakhirmu akan muncul di sini.
id.A focused place to learn, practise, and: Tempat untuk belajar, berlatih, dan melihat perkembangan bermain drum.
id.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Kenali drum kit
id.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Pelajari warna suara utama, atur kit dengan seimbang, dan jaga pendengaran.
id.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Hitung grid
id.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Baca not seperempat dan seperdelapan sebagai posisi waktu.
id.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Mainkan backbeat pertama
id.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Koordinasikan kick, snare, dan hi-hat menjadi groove utuh.
id.lesson.first-fill.title: Fill yang mendarat tepat
id.lesson.first-fill.summary: Pindahkan pukulan tunggal di kit lalu kembali rapi ke ketukan pertama.
id.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Kendali not seperenam belas
id.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Bagi satu ketukan menjadi empat not dengan jarak sama.
id.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Orkestrasi paradiddle
id.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Ubah pola tangan menjadi gerak musikal antara snare dan tom.
id.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Kuasai offbeat
id.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Tambahkan kick sinkop tanpa menggeser snare.
id.lesson.linear-fill.title: Rancang fill linear
id.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Buat fill tanpa dua anggota tubuh memukul bersamaan.
id.lesson.limb-independence.title: Kemandirian berlapis
id.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Pertahankan ostinato kaki sementara tangan memainkan frasa di atasnya.
id.lesson.five-four.title: Biasakan hitungan lima
id.lesson.five-four.summary: Kelompokkan 5/4 sebagai 3 + 2 untuk membentuk groove berulang.
id.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Bentuk lengkung dinamika
id.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Kendalikan ghost note, aksen, dan crescendo tanpa mengubah tempo.
id.lesson.three-over-two.title: Dengar tiga di atas dua
id.Check each item after you can do it comf: Centang setiap item setelah kamu bisa melakukannya dengan nyaman.
id.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Jalur belajar
id.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Dua belas pelajaran terpandu dari penataan pertama hingga poliritme.
id.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Pelatih
id.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Berlatih dengan ronde yang bisa diatur, tempo adaptif, input terkalibrasi, dan iringan setlist.
id.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Pad latihan
id.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Latih ketepatan waktu dengan lima suara drum dan umpan balik yang jelas.
id.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Rudimen
id.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Bangun kontrol lewat pola sticking, aksen, dan panduan terarah.
id.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Groove
id.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Ikuti pola orisinal rock, pop, funk, reggae, shuffle, Latin, dan birama ganjil dari dasar hingga mahir.
id.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Perpustakaan Lagu
id.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Buat bagian drum, atur repertoar, dan latih bagian lagu.
id.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Panduan Drum
id.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Atur set dengan nyaman, pahami setiap suara, dan lindungi pendengaran.
id.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Progres
id.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Lihat pelajaran selesai, skor terbaik, latihan terbaru, dan rangkaian harimu.
id.meta.app.description: Studio latihan terarah untuk teknik drum, ketepatan waktu, groove, dan kepercayaan diri bermusik.

vi.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: Làm quen với bộ trống
vi.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: Học các âm sắc chính, bố trí bộ trống cân bằng và bảo vệ thính giác.
vi.lesson.count-the-grid.title: Đếm ô nhịp
vi.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: Đọc nốt đen và nốt móc đơn như các vị trí trong thời gian.
vi.lesson.first-backbeat.title: Chơi backbeat đầu tiên
vi.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: Phối hợp kick, snare và hi-hat thành một groove hoàn chỉnh.
vi.lesson.first-fill.title: Fill kết thúc gọn
vi.lesson.first-fill.summary: Di chuyển các cú đánh đơn quanh bộ trống rồi trở lại phách một rõ ràng.
vi.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: Kiểm soát nốt móc kép
vi.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: Chia một phách thành bốn nốt cách đều nhau.
vi.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: Phối khí paradiddle
vi.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: Biến cách đánh tay thành chuyển động âm nhạc giữa snare và tom.
vi.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: Làm chủ phách lệch
vi.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: Thêm kick đảo phách mà không làm lệch snare.
vi.lesson.linear-fill.title: Thiết kế fill tuyến tính
vi.lesson.linear-fill.summary: Tạo fill không có hai chi đánh cùng lúc.
vi.lesson.limb-independence.title: Độc lập theo lớp
vi.lesson.limb-independence.summary: Giữ ostinato bằng chân trong khi hai tay chơi câu nhạc phía trên.
vi.lesson.five-four.title: Cảm nhận nhịp năm
vi.lesson.five-four.summary: Nhóm 5/4 thành 3 + 2 để tạo groove lặp lại.
vi.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: Tạo đường cong động lực
vi.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: Kiểm soát ghost note, nhấn và crescendo mà không đổi tempo.
vi.lesson.three-over-two.title: Nghe ba trên hai
vi.lesson.three-over-two.summary: Hiểu và phối hợp đa nhịp 3:2.
vi.Check each item after you can do it comf: Đánh dấu từng mục khi bạn có thể thực hiện thoải mái.
vi.dashboard.tool.learn.title: Lộ trình học
vi.dashboard.tool.learn.description: Mười hai bài học có hướng dẫn, từ cách bố trí đầu tiên đến đa tiết tấu.
vi.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: Huấn luyện
vi.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: Luyện tập với vòng chơi tùy chỉnh, nhịp độ thích ứng, đầu vào đã hiệu chỉnh và phần đệm theo danh sách bài.
vi.dashboard.tool.practice.title: Bàn tập
vi.dashboard.tool.practice.description: Rèn luyện nhịp với năm âm sắc trống và phản hồi rõ ràng.
vi.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: Kỹ thuật cơ bản
vi.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: Rèn khả năng kiểm soát với cách đánh tay, nhấn âm và hướng dẫn tập trung.
vi.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: Groove
vi.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: Theo các mẫu rock, pop, funk, reggae, shuffle, Latin và nhịp lẻ nguyên bản từ cơ bản đến nâng cao.
vi.dashboard.tool.songs.title: Thư viện bài hát
vi.dashboard.tool.songs.description: Tạo phần trống, sắp xếp tiết mục và luyện từng đoạn bài hát.
vi.dashboard.tool.kit.title: Hướng dẫn trống
vi.dashboard.tool.kit.description: Sắp đặt thoải mái, tìm hiểu từng âm sắc và bảo vệ thính giác.
vi.dashboard.tool.progress.title: Tiến độ
vi.dashboard.tool.progress.description: Xem bài học đã hoàn thành, điểm cao nhất, buổi tập gần đây và chuỗi ngày.

ja.Drum learning, in time: リズムに合わせてドラムを学ぼう
ja.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: あらゆるレベルのドラマー向けに、わかりやすいレッスン、演奏できるパターン、タイミングのフィードバックを提供します。アカウント不要。騒音の苦情も不要です。
ja.Play your first groove: 最初のグルーヴを演奏
ja.No setup or account needed. Use the five: 設定やアカウントは不要です。画面上の5つのパッドを使うか、カウントイン中にSpace、F、J、K、Lを押してください。
安定したテンポを選びます。
スタートを押してビートに合わせます。
何度か叩いてタイミングを確認します。
ja.Start with keyboard or touch: キーボードまたはタッチで始める
ja.Set up an e-drum kit in Trainer: トレーナーで電子ドラムを設定
ja.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: トレーナーはUSB MIDIまたは任意のマイク入力に対応しています。
スクロールではなく、練習スタジオ。
ja.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: 各ツールには役割があります。考え方を学び、動きを個別に練習してからグルーヴで演奏しましょう。
進捗はこのブラウザーに保存されます。
意識して練習し、音楽的に演奏しよう。
ja.Language preference saved on this device: この端末に言語を保存しました
ja.No translation is available for this lan: この言語の翻訳はまだありません。
ja.Live feedback: リアルタイムのフィードバック
最後のヒットがここに表示されます。
ja.Live timing score: リアルタイムのタイミングスコア
ja.Available for complete 4/4 bars: 完全な4/4小節で利用可能
次のビートはここから始まります。
ja.A focused place to learn, practise, and: ドラムを学び、練習し、上達を確かめる場所です。
ja.Play grooves and rudiments: グルーヴとルーディメンツを演奏
ja.Build consistency one round at a time: ラウンドごとに安定感を高める
ja.Interactive timing lab: インタラクティブなタイミングラボ
すべてのヒットを正しい位置へ。
ja.Groove and fill follow-along library: グルーヴとフィルのライブラリ
ヒットの間の余白を見つけよう。
長く演奏を続けられる環境を整えよう。
ja.Your work, visible: 練習の成果を見える化
耳にしたパートを書き留めよう。
ja.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: ドラムセットを知る
ja.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: 基本の音を覚え、無理のない配置にして、耳を守りましょう。
ja.lesson.count-the-grid.title: グリッドを数える
ja.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: 4分音符と8分音符を時間上の位置として読みます。
ja.lesson.first-backbeat.title: 最初のバックビートを作る
ja.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: キック、スネア、ハイハットを組み合わせてグルーヴを作ります。
ja.lesson.first-fill.title: 着地するフィル
ja.lesson.first-fill.summary: 単発の音をセット内で動かし、1拍目へきれいに戻ります。
ja.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: 16分音符をコントロール
ja.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: 1拍を均等な間隔の4音に分けます。
ja.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: パラディドルを展開する
ja.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: 手順をスネアとタムの間の音楽的な動きに変えます。
ja.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: 裏拍をつかむ
ja.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: スネアを崩さず、シンコペーションしたキックを加えます。
ja.lesson.linear-fill.title: リニア・フィルを組み立てる
ja.lesson.linear-fill.summary: 2つの手足が同時に叩かないフィルを作ります。
ja.lesson.limb-independence.title: 段階的な独立
ja.lesson.limb-independence.summary: 足でオスティナートを保ち、手でその上にフレーズを重ねます。
ja.lesson.five-four.title: 5拍子を自然に感じる
ja.lesson.five-four.summary: 5/4を3 + 2に分け、繰り返せるグルーヴを作ります。
ja.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: ダイナミクスの弧を描く
ja.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: テンポを変えずにゴーストノート、アクセント、クレッシェンドを操ります。
ja.lesson.three-over-two.title: 3対2を聴く
ja.lesson.three-over-two.summary: 3:2のポリリズムを理解して合わせます。
ja.Check each item after you can do it comf: 無理なくできるようになった項目にチェックを付けましょう。
ja.dashboard.tool.learn.title: 学習パス
ja.dashboard.tool.learn.description: 最初のセットアップからポリリズムまで、12のガイド付きレッスン。
ja.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: トレーナー
ja.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: 回数を調整できる練習、適応テンポ、調整済み入力、セットリスト再生に対応。
ja.dashboard.tool.practice.title: 練習パッド
ja.dashboard.tool.practice.description: 5つのドラム音色と明確なフィードバックでタイミングを練習。
ja.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: ルーディメンツ
ja.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: 手順、アクセント、的確なコーチングでコントロールを身につけます。
ja.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: グルーヴ
ja.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: ロック、ポップ、ファンク、レゲエ、シャッフル、ラテン、変拍子のオリジナルパターンを初級から上級まで演奏。
ja.dashboard.tool.songs.title: 曲ライブラリ
ja.dashboard.tool.songs.description: ドラムパートを作り、レパートリーを整理し、曲の各セクションを練習。
ja.dashboard.tool.kit.title: ドラムガイド
ja.dashboard.tool.kit.description: 無理のない姿勢でセットを整え、各音色を知り、聴覚を守りましょう。
ja.dashboard.tool.progress.title: 進捗
ja.dashboard.tool.progress.description: 完了したレッスン、最高スコア、最近の練習、連続日数を確認。
ja.meta.app.description: ドラムのテクニック、タイミング、グルーヴ、音楽的な自信を身につける練習スタジオ。

zh-Hans.Clear lessons, playable patterns, and ti: 为各个水平的鼓手提供清晰课程、可演奏节奏和节拍反馈。无需账号，也不用担心噪音投诉。
zh-Hans.No setup or account needed. Use the five: 无需设置或账号。使用屏幕上的五个鼓垫，或在预备拍时按空格、F、J、K 和 L。
尝试敲击几次，然后查看节奏。
zh-Hans.Set up an e-drum kit in Trainer: 在训练器中设置电子鼓
zh-Hans.Trainer lets you choose USB MIDI or opti: 训练器支持 USB MIDI 或可选麦克风输入。
专注练习，不是无尽的信息流。
zh-Hans.Each tool has one job. Learn the idea, i: 每个工具各有用途。先理解概念，单独练习动作，再把它融入律动。
你的进度保存在此浏览器中。
认真练习，富有乐感地演奏。
zh-Hans.No translation is available for this lan: 此语言的翻译暂不可用.
最近一次敲击会显示在这里。
zh-Hans.Available for complete 4/4 bars: 适用于完整的 4/4 小节
你的下一段节奏从这里开始。
zh-Hans.A focused place to learn, practise, and: 学习打鼓、练习并查看进步的空间。
把每一下都打在正确位置。
zh-Hans.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: 认识鼓组
zh-Hans.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: 了解主要鼓声，合理摆放鼓组，并保护听力。
zh-Hans.lesson.count-the-grid.title: 数清节奏网格
zh-Hans.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: 把四分音符和八分音符看作时间中的位置。
zh-Hans.lesson.first-backbeat.title: 打出第一个反拍
zh-Hans.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: 协调底鼓、军鼓和踩镲，组成完整律动。
zh-Hans.lesson.first-fill.title: 收得稳的加花
zh-Hans.lesson.first-fill.summary: 在鼓组上移动单击，并清楚地回到第一拍。
zh-Hans.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: 控制十六分音符
zh-Hans.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: 把一拍细分为四个间隔均匀的音符。
zh-Hans.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: 编排帕拉迪德尔
zh-Hans.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: 让手法在军鼓和通鼓之间形成音乐性的移动。
zh-Hans.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: 掌握弱拍
zh-Hans.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: 加入切分底鼓，同时保持军鼓稳定。
zh-Hans.lesson.linear-fill.title: 设计线性加花
zh-Hans.lesson.linear-fill.summary: 编排不会有两个肢体同时击打的加花。
zh-Hans.lesson.limb-independence.title: 分层练习独立性
zh-Hans.lesson.limb-independence.summary: 用脚保持固定节奏，让双手在上方演奏乐句。
zh-Hans.lesson.five-four.title: 让五拍自然流动
zh-Hans.lesson.five-four.summary: 把5/4分为3 + 2，建立可重复的律动。
zh-Hans.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: 塑造力度曲线
zh-Hans.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: 不改变速度，控制幽灵音、重音和渐强。
zh-Hans.lesson.three-over-two.title: 听出二拍上的三拍
zh-Hans.Check each item after you can do it comf: 能够轻松完成每一项后再勾选。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.learn.title: 学习路径
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.learn.description: 从首次设置到复合节奏的十二节引导课程。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.trainer.title: 训练器
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: 使用可调轮次、自适应速度、校准输入和歌单跟练来练习。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.practice.title: 练习垫
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.practice.description: 用五种可演奏的鼓组音色和清晰反馈训练节奏。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.rudiments.title: 基本功
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: 通过手法、重音和针对性指导建立控制力。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.grooves.title: 律动
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: 从简单到进阶，跟练原创摇滚、流行、放克、雷鬼、摇摆、拉丁和奇数拍节奏型。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.songs.title: 歌曲库
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.songs.description: 编写鼓组声部、整理曲目并练习歌曲片段。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.kit.title: 鼓组指南
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.kit.description: 舒适地设置鼓组，了解每种音色并保护听力。
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.progress.title: 进度
zh-Hans.dashboard.tool.progress.description: 查看已完成课程、最佳分数、近期练习和连续练习天数。
zh-Hans.meta.app.description: 专注于鼓技、节奏、律动和音乐自信的练习工作室。

zh-Hans.lesson.meet-the-kit.step.3: 重复练习，直到动作放松且均匀，再稍微加快速度。

zh-Hant.lesson.meet-the-kit.title: 認識鼓組
zh-Hant.lesson.meet-the-kit.summary: 了解主要鼓聲，合理擺放鼓組，並保護聽力。
zh-Hant.lesson.count-the-grid.title: 數清節奏網格
zh-Hant.lesson.count-the-grid.summary: 把四分音符和八分音符看作時間中的位置。
zh-Hant.lesson.first-backbeat.title: 打出第一個反拍
zh-Hant.lesson.first-backbeat.summary: 協調大鼓、小鼓和踩鈸，組成完整律動。
zh-Hant.lesson.first-fill.title: 收得穩的加花
zh-Hant.lesson.first-fill.summary: 在鼓組上移動單擊，並清楚地回到第一拍。
zh-Hant.lesson.sixteenth-control.title: 控制十六分音符
zh-Hant.lesson.sixteenth-control.summary: 把一拍細分為四個間隔均勻的音符。
zh-Hant.lesson.paradiddle-voices.title: 編排帕拉迪德爾
zh-Hant.lesson.paradiddle-voices.summary: 讓手法在小鼓和通鼓之間形成音樂性的移動。
zh-Hant.lesson.syncopated-pocket.title: 掌握弱拍
zh-Hant.lesson.syncopated-pocket.summary: 加入切分大鼓，同時保持小鼓穩定。
zh-Hant.lesson.linear-fill.title: 設計線性加花
zh-Hant.lesson.linear-fill.summary: 編排不會有兩個肢體同時擊打的加花。
zh-Hant.lesson.limb-independence.title: 分層練習獨立性
zh-Hant.lesson.limb-independence.summary: 用腳保持固定節奏，讓雙手在上方演奏樂句。
zh-Hant.lesson.five-four.title: 讓五拍自然流動
zh-Hant.lesson.five-four.summary: 把5/4分為3 + 2，建立可重複的律動。
zh-Hant.lesson.dynamic-arc.title: 塑造力度曲線
zh-Hant.lesson.dynamic-arc.summary: 不改變速度，控制幽靈音、重音和漸強。
zh-Hant.lesson.three-over-two.title: 聽出二拍上的三拍

zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.trainer.description: 使用可調整回合、自適應速度、校準輸入和歌單跟練來練習。

zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.practice.description: 用五種可演奏的鼓組音色和清楚回饋訓練節奏。

zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.rudiments.description: 透過手法、重音和針對性指導建立控制力。

zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.grooves.description: 從簡單到進階，跟練原創搖滾、流行、放克、雷鬼、搖擺、拉丁和奇數拍節奏型。
zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.songs.title: 歌曲庫
zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.songs.description: 編寫鼓組聲部、整理曲目並練習歌曲片段。
zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.kit.title: 鼓組指南
zh-Hant.dashboard.tool.kit.description: 舒適地設定鼓組，了解每種音色並保護聽力。

meet-the-kit.idea: A drum kit is a group of distinct voices. A relaxed setup lets each limb reach its instrument without twisting or lifting the shoulders.
steps: Name kick, snare, hi-hat, tom, and crash. On the Practice Pad, those voices use Space, F, J, K, and L.
Sit so your thighs slope slightly down and your feet can rest on the pedals without reaching.
Use hearing protection around acoustic drums and keep headphone or monitor levels comfortable.

count-the-grid.idea: A steady beat is a set of evenly spaced positions. Eighth notes split each beat into two equal spaces.
steps: Say “1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &” at a comfortable pace. The numbers are the beats; each “&” sits halfway between them.
Watch the Practice Pad playhead move through the numbered grid.
Tap the snare evenly on every eighth-note position, then repeat while counting aloud.

first-backbeat.idea: A common rock and pop groove pairs kick on beats 1 and 3 with snare on beats 2 and 4. Even hi-hat eighths connect the pattern.
steps: Count “1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &” before playing.
Add the hi-hat on each number and “&”. Keep its volume even.
Add kick on 1 and 3, then snare on 2 and 4. Keep the count moving through the whole bar.

first-fill.idea: A fill adds a short phrase near the end of a groove. A clear downbeat after the fill makes the transition feel settled.
steps: Play a simple groove for three beats and keep counting through beat 4.
Use even eighth notes across the snare and tom on beat 4.
Land kick and crash together on the next beat 1. Start slowly enough to make that landing comfortable.

sixteenth-control.idea: Sixteenth notes divide a beat into four equal positions, commonly counted “1 e & a”. Relaxed, even spacing matters more than speed.
steps: Say “1 e & a” several times without playing.
Play four quiet, even snare taps on each beat.
Keep your hands low and relaxed. Increase tempo only while every subdivision stays even.

paradiddle-voices.idea: A single paradiddle is R-L-R-R, L-R-L-L. The repeated strokes are doubles; accents can make the sticking easier to hear.
steps: Say the sticking out loud and make the repeated hand change feel smooth.
Accent the first note of each four-note group while keeping the other notes lower.
Move selected notes from snare to tom without changing the sticking or pulse.

syncopated-pocket.idea: Syncopation places a note between the main beats. Keep the snare backbeat steady while the kick adds offbeat movement.
steps: Count the eighth-note grid and keep snare on beats 2 and 4.
Add one kick on an “&” while keeping the other notes unchanged.
Repeat the bar and notice whether the offbeat kick pulls the next beat early.

linear-fill.idea: A linear phrase gives each subdivision to one voice at a time. Separating the voices makes a fill clear and controlled.
steps: Count each subdivision at a slow tempo.
Play the kick, snare, and tom sequence one note at a time; let each sound finish before the next voice.
Keep the final subdivision clear so the next groove can begin on beat 1.

limb-independence.idea: Independence grows by layering one steady part at a time. Make the foot pattern automatic before adding a hand part.
steps: Tap a steady kick pulse and count aloud for several bars.
Keep the kick going while adding a simple hi-hat pulse.
Add the snare backbeat last. If a layer slips, remove it and rebuild from the pulse.

five-four.idea: Five-four has five quarter-note beats in each bar. Grouping it as 3 + 2 gives the phrase a repeatable shape.
steps: Count “1 2 3, 1 2” and accent each group’s first beat.
Keep the hi-hat evenly spaced across all five beats.
Place the kick and snare while keeping the 3 + 2 count audible.

dynamic-arc.idea: Dynamics describe how softly or strongly you play. A quiet note and an accent should differ in volume while staying in time.
steps: Play one bar of soft notes at an easy tempo.
Repeat with one clear accent, keeping the remaining notes soft.
Build the volume gradually over four bars without speeding up.

three-over-two.idea: A 3:2 polyrhythm places three evenly spaced notes over the same span as two evenly spaced notes. Learn each pulse separately before combining them.
steps: Clap two even notes across a steady two-beat span.
Over the same span, sing three evenly spaced notes: “1, trip, let”.
Keep the two-beat pulse in your foot while speaking the three-note phrase. Begin slowly.

rudiments.name: Single Stroke Roll
rudiments.coaching: Let the stick rebound; match the height of both hands.
rudiments.description: Even alternating hands, the foundation of speed and control.

rudiments.name: Double Stroke Roll
rudiments.coaching: Make the second stroke rebound, not squeeze.
rudiments.description: Two controlled strokes per hand with consistent spacing.

rudiments.name: Single Paradiddle
rudiments.sticking: R L R R  L R L L
rudiments.coaching: Accent the first note of each four-note group.
rudiments.description: Alternating singles and doubles that unlock orchestration.

rudiments.name: Six Stroke Roll
rudiments.sticking: R L L R R L
rudiments.coaching: Keep the doubles low and the outside singles relaxed.
rudiments.description: A flowing six-note phrase for fills and solos.

rudiments.name: Flam Control
rudiments.coaching: Keep the grace note low and close to the main stroke.
rudiments.description: Four evenly spaced flams; the grace note should lead each main stroke without becoming a double stroke.

rudiments.name: Single Drag Taps
rudiments.coaching: Keep both grace notes quiet and resolve them into one clear tap.
rudiments.description: A measured drag before each main note, with the final tap aligned to the pulse.

rudiments.name: Buzz Roll Control
rudiments.coaching: Use relaxed pressure and let the buzz sustain evenly.
rudiments.description: Four controlled buzz strokes leading into the pulse, paced slowly for clarity.

grooves.name: Quarter Note Pulse
grooves.focus: Keep an even pulse while placing kick and snare
grooves.description: Start with one hi-hat note per beat, kick on 1 and 3, and snare on 2 and 4.

grooves.name: First Backbeat
grooves.focus: Steady eighth notes and a strong backbeat
grooves.description: Your first complete beat: hats on eighths, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4.

grooves.name: Straight Pop Beat
grooves.focus: Keep the eighth-note hat even and the backbeat clear
grooves.description: A steady pop foundation with a consistent kick, snare, and closed hi-hat pattern.

grooves.name: Two Beat Rock
grooves.focus: Hear a strong snare on beats 2 and 4
grooves.description: A stripped-down rock groove that leaves room to focus on the backbeat.

grooves.name: Four on the Floor
grooves.focus: Keep four steady kick notes under the backbeat
grooves.description: Kick every beat, snare on 2 and 4, and even eighth-note hi-hat.

grooves.name: Half Time Rock
grooves.focus: Leave space and place the snare on beat 3
grooves.description: The pulse stays steady while the snare lands once per bar on beat 3.

grooves.name: Punk Drive
grooves.focus: Keep the eighth notes even at a brisk tempo
grooves.description: A fast, straight eighth-note groove with a firm kick and backbeat.

grooves.name: Disco Offbeat Hat
grooves.focus: Lift the offbeat hi-hat without rushing the kick
grooves.description: Four-on-the-floor kick with a lifted offbeat hat accent and steady backbeat.

grooves.name: Motown Pocket
grooves.focus: Make the kick and backbeat feel relaxed and consistent
grooves.description: A warm eighth-note pocket with a small kick pickup into beat 3.

grooves.name: Reggae One Drop
grooves.focus: Leave beat 1 open and land the band hit on beat 3
grooves.description: Kick and snare meet on beat 3 while the hi-hat carries the pulse.

grooves.name: Reggae Steppers
grooves.focus: Keep an even quarter-note kick beneath the hat
grooves.description: A steady kick on every beat with a light backbeat on 2 and 4.

grooves.name: Ska Upbeat
grooves.focus: Place the snare on the offbeat eighth notes
grooves.description: A brisk upbeat pattern with snare on the '&' counts and kick on the quarter pulse.

grooves.name: Country Train Beat
grooves.focus: Alternate kick and snare evenly under the hats
grooves.description: A driving train-like pattern with an alternating low and backbeat voice.

grooves.name: Blues Shuffle
grooves.focus: Keep the long-short triplet feel relaxed
grooves.description: A swung triplet-grid shuffle with kick on 1 and 3 and snare on 2 and 4.

grooves.name: Jazz Swing Ride Pattern
grooves.focus: Ride the triplet pulse and keep the feathered kick quiet
grooves.description: A basic swung ride pattern with a light hi-hat on beats 2 and 4. Use the hi-hat voice as your ride cymbal guide.

grooves.name: Bossa Nova
grooves.focus: Keep the cross-stick backbeat while the kick syncopates
grooves.description: An original bossa-inspired coordination study with a syncopated kick and steady eighth-note guide.

grooves.name: Samba Drive
grooves.focus: Coordinate the repeating kick figure against the backbeat
grooves.description: A brisk, original samba-inspired kit exercise with repeated bass drum notes.

grooves.name: Syncopated Funk Pocket
grooves.focus: Place offbeat kicks without disturbing the backbeat
grooves.description: Anchor the snare while the kick moves between the pulse; keep sixteenth-note subdivisions clear.

grooves.name: Broken Beat
grooves.focus: Count the sixteenths while the accents shift around the bar
grooves.description: A syncopated study in displaced kick and snare accents over a steady subdivision.

grooves.name: Five-Four Drive
grooves.focus: Feel five as 3 + 2

grooves.name: Seven-Eight Grouping

grooves.name: Five-Four Half Time

grooves.name: Quarter Kick Backbeat

grooves.name: Slow Rock Drive

grooves.name: Kick Pickup Intro

grooves.name: Tom Pulse
grooves.focus: Move between tom and snare while keeping the pulse
grooves.description: A simple alternating tom and snare exercise with an eighth-note guide.

grooves.name: Three-Quarter Waltz

grooves.name: First Six-Eight Pulse

grooves.name: Quarter-Note Backbeat

grooves.name: Hat Accent Alternation

grooves.name: Crash and Land

grooves.name: Four Even Kicks

grooves.description: Four quarter-note kicks create a stable base under the two-and-four backbeat.

grooves.name: Rock Kick Pickup

grooves.name: Rock Offbeat Kick
grooves.focus: Keep an offbeat kick from pulling the snare forward
grooves.description: Shift one bass drum note to the '&' after beat two while the snare anchors two and four.

grooves.name: Indie Open Space

grooves.name: Sixteenth R&B Pocket

grooves.description: A lightly syncopated kick and snare pattern over a full sixteenth-note hat guide.

grooves.name: Ghost Note Pocket

grooves.name: Sixteenth Disco Drive
grooves.focus: Keep the kick on each beat while the hand subdivides
grooves.description: Four-on-the-floor kick under a continuous sixteenth-note hat pattern and steady snare.

grooves.name: Classic Shuffle Pocket
grooves.focus: Keep the skipped triplet note light
grooves.description: A swung triplet hat line with kick on one and three and snare on two and four.

grooves.name: Walking Shuffle Kick
grooves.focus: Maintain the shuffle while the kick walks through the bar

grooves.name: Ride and Comp

grooves.name: Ska Two-Step
grooves.focus: Keep the upbeat snares light and even
grooves.description: A brisk two-and-four kick with snare notes on the eighth-note upbeats.

grooves.name: Reggae Rockers
grooves.focus: Keep the kick on each beat with a relaxed backbeat
grooves.description: A steady roots-style kit exercise with four kicks and a light snare on two and four.

grooves.name: Afrobeat Interlock
